# GitOnBoard — Master Project Specification

## 1. Project Identity

**Title**: GitOnBoard: A Repository-Aware Multi-Agent Verification and Automated Repair Framework for AI-Generated Code  
**Type**: Final-Year Engineering / Research Framework  
**Core Purpose**: Enhance the correctness, requirement completeness, and architectural compliance of code generated by AI coding agents through repository-aware multi-agent verification, executable evidence collection, and automated repair.

---

## 2. Core Problem & Objective

AI coding agents frequently generate syntactically plausible code that fails in production due to:
- Missing edge-case handlers or incomplete requirement implementation.
- Invented APIs, non-existent symbols, or uninstalled dependencies.
- Architectural boundary violations.
- Code passing existing tests while failing overall requirement intent.

**GitOnBoard Objective**:
Determine whether adversarial multi-agent verification, explicit Implementation Contracts, executable evidence, and automated repair measurably improve the reliability and requirement completion rate of AI coding agents.

---

## 3. Core Architecture & Workflow

```text
User Requirement
       ↓
Repository Intelligence Engine (Tree-sitter + RIM Graph + Fact Store)
       ↓
Requirement Decomposition (Implementation Contract + Expected Impact Analysis)
       ↓
Coding Agent Adapter (Git Worktree Sandbox)
       ↓
Generated Code Patch
       ↓
Adversarial Multi-Agent Verifier (Static + Dynamic + Semantic Evidence)
       ↓
   PASS / FAIL Verdict
       ├─► PASS ──► Final Verified Implementation
       └─► FAIL ──► Defect Report ──► Repair Agent ──► Re-verification (Max 3 passes)
```

---

## 4. Architectural Invariants (Non-Goals)

GitOnBoard is **NOT**:
- A replacement for Codex or Google Antigravity.
- An enterprise DevOps platform or SaaS system.
- A distributed microservice cluster.

**Simplification Rule**:
- Infrastructure is simplified (Modular Monolith: Next.js 16 + FastAPI + PostgreSQL + local Git worktrees).
- Core Intelligence is preserved (Tree-sitter AST, RIM graph, Layer 4 Fact Store, Implementation Contracts, Multi-Agent Verifiers, Automated Repair Loop, Benchmark Evaluation).
